data.name: Mohidul
data.gender_notes: Mohidul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana', meaning 'to attract' or 'to charm'. The name Mohidul signifies the grace of the moon-god, Chandra. In Hindu mythology, the moon-god is believed to bestow blessings of wisdom, prosperity, and protection upon his devotees. The name Mohidul carries the meaning “Moon-god's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindi tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mohidul usually hope their child will grow to embody moon-god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Grace and blessings from the moon-god.
data.etymology: Mohidul belongs to the Hindi linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon-god's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mohidul total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The Hindu name "Raj" is derived from the Sanskrit word 'raja' which means 'king'. In ancient India, the title 'Raja' was given to the rulers of kingdoms and signified power, dominion, and authority. Today, the name Raj is popular worldwide and carries a regal connotation, representing confidence, leadership, and nobility.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, every name has a spiritual significance and is believed to bestow certain blessings. The name Raj is no exception. It is also believed that the name Raj brings prosperity and success in life, as it is associated with the divine ruler, Indra.
